hints.tr: Tekrarlanabilir yöntemleri bir listede tut; `method.upper() in IDEMPOTENT` doğrudan `True` ya da `False` verir.
hints.en: Keep the idempotent methods in a list; `method.upper() in IDEMPOTENT` gives `True` or `False` directly.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
IDEMPOTENT = ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "PUT", "DELETE"]


def can_retry(method):
    return method.upper() in IDEMPOTENT


failed = [
    ("GET", "/books"),
    ("POST", "/orders"),
    ("DELETE", "/books/7"),
    ("patch", "/books/7"),
    ("PUT", "/books/7"),
]
for method, path in failed:
    if can_retry(method):
        print("retry", method.upper(), path)
    else:
        print("ask first", method.upper(), path)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python

failed = [

```
